skill.name: file-name-wizard
skill.description: Audit repository filenames and naming conventions against CLAUDE.md standards, directory patterns, and common codebase naming practices.
skill.summary: Find inconsistent filenames, weak naming patterns, and missing naming standards across a repository.
skill.author: Cygnusfear

security_audit.summary: All static external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and fenced examples in SKILL.md. No evidence found of prompt injection, network exfiltration, unsafe command execution, or malicious intent.

static_findings.snippet: Read all `CLAUDE.md` files in the repository:
- Mixed conventions (e.g., `userAuth.service.ts` mixing camelCase and dot notation)
- `src/lib/` - No clear convention (mix of all patterns)
| `src/auth-v2.ts` | Version suffix | `src/auth.ts` | Migration files not allowed |

content.value_statement: Inconsistent filenames make repositories harder to scan, review, and maintain. This skill audits naming rules, finds mismatches, and produces a prioritized cleanup report.
actual_capabilities: Finds source, test, config, and documentation files for naming review.
Reads CLAUDE.md files to extract explicit naming standards.
Compares filenames with directory patterns and common conventions.
Flags vague, temporary, dated, misleading, and inconsistent names.
Creates a prioritized naming audit report with suggested replacements.
Summarizes systemic naming issues and missing standards.
limitations: It audits naming only and does not rename files automatically.
It depends on available repository files and documented standards.
Suggested names may need team review before implementation.
Large repositories may require more time to inspect completely.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Refactor Plan
use_cases.description: Review filename consistency before a planned cleanup or architecture change.

use_cases.title: Enforce Repository Standards
use_cases.description: Compare current filenames with CLAUDE.md rules and directory conventions.

use_cases.title: Review a New Codebase
use_cases.description: Identify naming patterns, outliers, and missing documentation during onboarding.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Naming Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you want a broad repository naming review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this repository for filename and directory naming issues. Use any CLAUDE.md standards you find.

prompt_templates.title: Directory-Focused Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one area has naming drift.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the files under the services and utilities directories. Compare them with nearby naming patterns and standards.

prompt_templates.title: Standards Gap Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when conventions are unclear or undocumented.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find directories with weak or missing naming standards. Suggest what should be documented for each area.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritized Cleanup Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when planning a staged naming cleanup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized naming audit. Group issues by severity, directory, and cleanup risk, with clear suggested names.

output: Executive summary with files audited and issue counts.
Priority list of temporary, generic, and inconsistent filenames.
Suggested replacement names with short reasons.

output_examples.input: Check whether service files follow local standards.
output: Directory pattern summary for service files.
List of filenames that miss required suffixes or casing rules.

output_examples.input: Find naming standards missing from this codebase.
output: Directories with no clear naming rules.
Observed implicit patterns from nearby files.

best_practices: Review CLAUDE.md standards before judging filenames.
Validate suggested names against file contents and nearby patterns.
Use the report to plan safe renames with import updates.
anti_patterns: Do not rename files directly during the audit.
Do not apply one naming rule across unrelated directories without evidence.
Do not treat every index or helper file as wrong without reading context.

faq.question: Does this skill rename files?
faq.answer: No. It audits filenames and suggests better names, but it does not change repository files.

faq.question: Which standards does it use?
faq.answer: It starts with CLAUDE.md files, then checks implicit directory patterns and common language conventions.

faq.question: Can it review large repositories?
faq.answer: Yes, but a full audit may take longer because it checks filenames, locations, and file contents.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a naming audit report with issue severity, affected directories, examples, and suggested replacement names.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it find missing naming documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies directories without clear standards and suggests topics to add to CLAUDE.md.
